source_prompt:
# Instructions for accurately documenting structural defects in a bridge maintenance report

1. Start with the maintenance records.
2.
completion:
Document any defects that are found.
    1. If a defective structural member can be replaced with a stock part, replace it and document any defects that were uncovered during that process.
    1. If a defective structural member would take some work to find a replacement source, make a list of the parts needed and include it in the report.
1. Following the manufacture's instructions for the materials in use, calculate and report on any expected defects of the bridge and include any notes on the rate of degradation.
1. Follow the manufacturer's recommended maintenance schedule.
1. Document any expected defects that appear to be occurring at an unscheduled rate.
1. Compare the inspection with the manufacture's installation notes and any other notes on the installation process.
1. Document how these instructions were followed (or not).
1. Add comments about the construction site.
1. Note whether the defects found are consistent with the
